by sending dust.

types.name: Config
docs: Program-wide settings. One per program, at PDA ["config"]. Lives on L1 and is never delegated,
so rollup instructions read a cloned, read-only copy.
Layout history: v1 (M1 first deploy) had no `reserved` tail. v2 appends it. `migrate_config`
upgrades a v1 account in place.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin handover: set by `propose_admin`, cleared by `accept_admin`.

fields.name: dev_wallet
docs: Receives rake.

fields.name: max_buy_in
docs: Largest buy-in any table may accept, in the table token's base units. This is the per-table
stake cap from the M0 custody decision.

fields.name: paused
docs: When true, no new tables or buy-ins. Existing players can still leave.

fields.name: escape_idle_secs
docs: How long a table's last L1 commit must be idle before an emergency undelegation request.
Carved from the old reserved bytes, so existing v2 accounts read 0 = default.

fields.name: auditor
docs: May read finished hands' action logs (`open_log`); default = no auditor. Carved from the
reserved bytes, so existing accounts read "none".

fields.name: escape_idle_secs
docs: 0 = default (1 hour).

types.name: Deck
docs: The current hand's shuffle inputs and deck. Rollup-only and readable by nobody. Seeds are for the
next hand while the table is idle; `end_hand` copies everything public into the `HandRecord`.

fields.name: seed_mask
docs: Bit i set = seat i committed a seed.

fields.name: seed_owners
docs: Who committed each seed. A seed counts only while its committer still holds the seat.

fields.name: entropy
docs: Public stand-in for the VRF output (see dealing.rs).

fields.name: log_secret
docs: The hand's log secret (see `dealing::log_secret_of`), handed to the log by `begin_hand`.

fields.name: current_seat
docs: Reference seat for turn order (C# `CurrentSeat`).

fields.name: to_act
docs: Seat whose decision is awaited, or NONE.

fields.name: runout
docs: Every remaining opponent is all-in or folded: no more betting, the board runs out.

fields.name: stack
docs: Chips behind (not yet committed this hand).

fields.name: current_bet
docs: Committed in the current betting round.

fields.name: total
docs: Committed across the whole hand (drives side pots).

types.name: Hand
docs: One seat's hole cards. Rollup-only and readable only by the seat's current owner. Created when a
player sits and closed when they leave.

fields.name: reader
docs: The seat's reader key (M8): it may commit the seat's seeds, as it may act, so a client plays
without a wallet prompt per hand.

types.name: HandLog
docs: A hand's action log: rollup-only, readable by the players dealt into the current hand (set by
`begin_hand`), and once that hand is over also by the config's auditor (`open_log`). Holds the
entries (up to LOG_CAPACITY) and a hash chain over all of them: it starts at sha256(table, hand
number, secret) and becomes sha256(previous, street, seat, kind, committed) per action. The
secret comes from the hand's VRF output; without it a short hand's bets could be found by
trying every likely log against the public hash (M6 review). The final hash is published in the hand record, so each player can check the log
they were shown. Zero-copy: read in place, never copied onto the stack.

fields.name: secret
docs: The hand's log secret (first link of the hash chain); readers need it to check the hash.

fields.name: readers_len
docs: How many of `readers` are set.

fields.name: readers
docs: The reader keys of the players dealt into this hand, as set by `begin_hand`.

fields.name: audited_by
docs: The auditor this hand's log was opened to (default = not yet), so `open_log` runs once.

types.name: HandRecord
docs: The last finished hand, readable by anyone so anyone can recompute its deck (tests/verifier.ts).
Rollup-only and overwritten each hand; a copy goes into the table (`last_record`), so each
commit publishes the latest hand on Solana.

fields.name: board_len
docs: Board cards reached (0, 3, 4 or 5); every card in the deck is public after the hand anyway.

fields.name: log_hash
docs: Final hash of the hand's action log (see `HandLog`). Bets themselves stay private.

fields.name: log_len
docs: Actions in the hand (the log may hold fewer, see LOG_CAPACITY).

types.name: Invites
docs: Invite list for an invite-only table. Lives on L1 (not delegated); the rollup reads a copy.
Stores sha256(table || wallet), not wallets, so the public account doesn't say who's invited.

types.name: Ledger
docs: The private part of a table: seats, stacks and money. Rollup-only (never committed, never on
L1); readable only by the players seated at the table.

fields.name: escrow_owed
docs: What the table owes: sum of stacks + unpaid rake.

fields.name: escrow_balance
docs: Escrow token balance seen right after the last money move.

fields.name: salt
docs: Secret salt, refreshed from the VRF every hand, so the public fingerprint can't be guessed
from likely wallets and amounts. All zeros until the first hand is dealt.

fields.name: game
docs: The current (or last) hand's betting state. Seat stacks above are the stacks between hands;
during a hand the live stacks are in `game` and are written back when it ends.

types.name: LogEntry
docs: One action in a hand's log (16 bytes, zero-copy).

fields.name: committed
docs: The seat's total chips committed this hand after the action.

fields.name: kind
docs: engine action kind (FOLD..ALL_IN), or LOG_SMALL_BLIND / LOG_BIG_BLIND; LOG_TIMEOUT is or-ed
in when the program acted for a player whose time ran out.

types.name: Seat
docs: One seat. An empty seat has `player == Pubkey::default()`.

fields.name: reader
docs: Key that may read the ledger and this seat's hand in the TEE. It is a separate key chosen by
the player's client, so permission lists (which MagicBlock's RPC shows to anyone) never name
the wallet.

fields.name: stack
docs: Chips the player has at the table, in the table token's base units.

fields.name: deposited
docs: Everything this player has put in at this seat (before rake), for the audit trail.

fields.name: sitting_out
docs: Missed a hand by not committing a seed: no longer waited for. Committing a seed brings the
seat back from the next hand on.

types.name: Table
docs: The public part of a table. Delegated to the TEE rollup and committed to L1, so everything here
becomes public on L1. Who sits where, stacks and money totals live in the private `Ledger`;
only its fingerprint is here. Fixed layout, no `Option` (M1 lesson).

fields.name: seat_mask
docs: Bit i set = seat i taken. Lets a new player pick a free seat without reading the ledger.

fields.name: rake_bps
docs: Copied from config at creation, so later rake changes don't affect open tables.

fields.name: last_activity_ts
docs: Rollup clock at the last money move; used by the escape-hatch rule.

fields.name: ledger_hash
docs: sha256 of the ledger after the last money move, and how many moves there have been.
Players' clients keep their own seat record and can check it against this.

fields.name: hand_no
docs: Hands started at this table (the current one, if one is running).

fields.name: hand_state
docs: HAND_IDLE, HAND_SHUFFLING or HAND_DEALT.

fields.name: button
docs: Dealer button of the current or last hand (meaningless while `hand_no == 0`).

fields.name: dealt_mask
docs: Seats dealt into the current hand.

fields.name: vrf_requested_ts
docs: Rollup clock when randomness was last requested.

fields.name: vrf_nonce
docs: Bumped on every randomness request (and abort). The callback must echo the current value,
so only the latest request can deal.

fields.name: shuffle_started_ts
docs: Rollup clock when the current hand started shuffling (the abort deadline counts from here).

fields.name: turn_deadline
docs: While a hand is played: when the awaited player's turn runs out.

fields.name: idle_since
docs: When the table last became idle (opened, or a hand ended or was aborted); the seed window
counts from here. Sitting down doesn't move it, so nobody can stall hands by re-seating.

fields.name: last_commit_ts
docs: Rollup clock at the table's last commit to L1.

fields.name: last_record
docs: The last finished hand's public record (all zero before the first). Copied here at the end
of every hand so each commit of the table publishes the latest hand on L1; the backend
archives every hand from the rollup's `HandRecord`.

fields.name: committed_ledger_seq
docs: M10: `ledger_seq` and `hand_no` at the last commit. Anyone but the creator may commit only after one of
them changed, so outsiders can't make an idle table pay a commit every 15 minutes (review L4). Taken
from the reserved bytes, so the account keeps its size and older tables read zeros.

fields.name: refund
docs: Lamports returned to the creator (table rent and escape payer).

fields.name: vault_seed
docs: The current vault's extra seed; all zeros = the first vault.
